delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.description: It’s removed for everyone at once, and these go with it:

items.chats: Page chats and Ask chats about its pages, for everyone
items.shares: Apps, datasets and link cards shared with it (their owners keep them)

delete.restore: Nothing is erased: a workspace admin can restore it, with everything in it, from Settings → Deleted Spaces.

dataset.description-new: A dataset of yours in {{space}}: everyone who reads the Space can read it.
dataset.description-existing: Everyone who reads {{space}} can read the dataset you add.
dataset.none: Every dataset you manage is in a Space already.
